title: Mac：科研环境与学术模板更新

items.description: 查看芯片、内存和磁盘余量，按分析类型了解当前电脑能否运行以及需要准备什么。
items.en: Check your processor, memory and free disk space, with guidance for each analysis workflow.

items.description: 实测下载源速度并自动选择，也可手动切换；下载、安装和验证阶段更清楚，取消后可重新准备。
items.en: Measure download sources and choose automatically or manually, with clearer download, installation and verification stages.

items.description: 新增从双端 FASTQ 开始的 RNA-seq、CUT&Tag 分析流程，可衔接质量检查、比对和后续分析。
items.en: Start RNA-seq and CUT&Tag workflows from paired-end FASTQ files, connecting quality checks, alignment and downstream analysis.

items.description: 新增经典学术、极简期刊、暗场成像和文献精读四套模板，便于组织组会汇报与论文解读。
items.en: Four new academic presentation templates support lab meetings and paper discussions.

items.description: 改进文件工具调用兼容性，支持使用已有参考索引；数据转换失败时保留已有结果，减少重复工作。
items.en: Improve file-tool compatibility, accept existing reference indexes and preserve previous results when a conversion fails.

title: 更新更顺畅，下载更轻便

items.description: 修复部分版本无法启用应用内更新的问题，可直接在 BioSeeki 中检查和下载新版。
items.en: Restore in-app update checks and downloads for affected Mac releases.

items.description: 安装时提供等待说明，避免重复打开旧版影响升级，完成后自动打开。
items.en: Explain the installation wait, prevent reopening the old version from interrupting an upgrade, and reopen automatically when finished.

items.description: 复用未变化的大资源，减少后续更新的下载量；首次更新或无法复用时仍可下载完整更新包。
items.en: Reuse unchanged large resources to reduce subsequent downloads, with a full-update fallback when reuse is unavailable.

title: 让长任务更连贯，PPT 预览更顺畅

items.description: 改进长回答和多步骤任务的继续处理，减少生成过程中意外结束或停在操作说明的情况。
items.en: Improve continuation of long answers and multi-step tasks, reducing early stops and replies that describe an action without carrying it out.

items.description: 改进长对话的整理与任务衔接，方便接着已有的研究进展继续工作。
items.en: Improve context organization in long conversations so work can continue from existing research progress.

items.description: 任务结束时核对清单，明确区分已完成和仍待核对的步骤，便于查看下一步。
items.en: Reconcile the checklist when a turn ends and distinguish completed steps from those still needing review.

items.description: 未改动的演示文稿可复用已有预览，减少重复等待，方便继续检查和调整内容。
items.en: Reuse existing previews for unchanged presentations, reducing repeated waits while reviewing and refining slides.

title: 在应用内下载更新，重启即可升级

items.description: 按日常、进阶和深度选择七款模型，可接入自定义模型；DeepSeek 显示峰谷时段与倍率。
items.en: Choose from seven models grouped by everyday, advanced and deep tasks, or connect your own provider. DeepSeek includes peak and off-peak pricing information.

items.description: 在 BioSeeki 内检查版本和下载更新，左下角图标持续显示后台下载状态；完成后，点击「重启更新」即可升级。
items.en: Check and download updates inside BioSeeki. The sidebar icon keeps download progress visible; restart to install when you are ready.

items.description: 复用上一次更新包中未变化的内容，减少后续更新的下载量；首次更新或无法复用时自动下载完整更新包。
items.en: Reuse unchanged content from the previous update to reduce later downloads, with a full-download fallback when needed.

items.description: 关闭面板后继续后台下载，网络或磁盘问题可在面板内重试，已有对话、课题和设置保留。
items.en: Continue downloading after closing the panel, retry network or storage failures, and keep conversations, projects and settings.

title: 按任务选择模型，接入自己的模型服务

items.description: 按「日常、进阶、深度」分组查看模型，自行选择本次任务使用的模型，并查看对应的积分倍率。
items.en: Choose a model for each task from Everyday, Advanced and Deep groups, with credit multipliers shown alongside each model.

items.description: 从模型菜单直接进入配置，接入自己的模型供应商、本地服务或兼容 OpenAI、Anthropic 协议的 API。
items.en: Open custom model settings from the model menu and connect a provider, local service, or OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API.

items.description: 悬停模型即可查看默认思考等级，在不同模型之间移动时即时更新。
items.en: Hover over a model to see its default reasoning level, with immediate updates as you move between models.

items.description: 改进记录中公式的呈现与 Word、PDF 导出，让记录内容更易阅读和整理。
items.en: Improve formula rendering and Word/PDF export for clearer experimental records.

items.description: 在工作台检查分析环境，按提示准备任务需要的工具与依赖。
items.en: Check the scientific environment from the workspace and prepare the tools needed for an analysis.

items.description: 更清楚地展示任务进展、需要补充的信息与下一步操作，方便接着推进已有工作。
items.en: See task progress, missing information and the next action more clearly when continuing work.

items.description: 改进定期整理与候选记忆的展示，方便查看、核对和管理课题中积累的背景。
items.en: Review consolidation results and candidate memories, and manage the context accumulated in a project.

items.description: 改进文献匹配、日报与周报，让新增文献及检索状态更容易查看。
items.en: Improve literature matching and daily and weekly digests, with clearer retrieval status.

items.description: 完善记录附件与 Word、PDF 导出，改进中文内容和附件链接的呈现。
items.en: Improve experimental-record attachments and Word/PDF export, including Chinese text and attachment links.

items.description: 改进论断与来源的关联检查，让需要进一步核对的引用更容易识别。
items.en: Improve checks between claims and sources so citations needing review are easier to identify.

items.description: 从 DMG 首次打开后，可按提示安装到「应用程序」，完成后自动打开。
items.en: On the first launch from the DMG, install into Applications and open the installed app automatically.

items.description: 替换已有版本前单独确认；从「应用程序」正常启动时跳过安装引导。
items.en: Confirm replacement of an existing app; subsequent launches from Applications skip the installation guide.
